title: Windy Mind agent self-view (contract C16, Nervous System S18.2 + S18.5)
description: GET /v1/agents/me: what powers the CALLING AGENT. Callers: an EPT / EPT+agent, or a wm_ key (bound to a passport or not). People get 403 agents_only (owners use /v1/agents/{passport}/power, menu.v1). The owner-only profile fields of menu.v1 1.1.0 (chain_detail, last_served, tier, key, account_kind) are NEVER on this route. Reload signal: `config_version` is a hash of the SETTINGS only (identity, default_model, chain, source, state, state_reason), never of usage, and is also sent as a weak ETag; If-None-Match with it returns 304 when nothing an agent must reload on has changed. Additive changes only within v1. 1.1.0 (S18.3, Hub 10-06): `may_pick` (what this agent may switch itself to; no prices) and `picked_by`; PUT /v1/agents/me/model lets the agent switch ITSELF within may_pick (flag MIND_AGENT_SELF_SWITCH, off = 404); DELETE returns it to the owner's setting. The owner always wins (an owner PUT on /power overrides at once; mode none freezes it), a switch never lifts a pause/off/switch, and each switch sends the owner a Hub Inbox notice (kind agent_switched_model) with a one-tap undo. config_version changes on a switch.

x-endpoints.auth: agent (EPT / EPT+agent / wm_ key bound to a passport)

responses.429: switch_rate (> 10 switches per hour per agent; Retry-After)

chain.description: this agent's model chain (main then backups); null for a key without a passport (it follows its owner's order)

state.description: off/paused when a grant or a switch (breaker) stops this agent

state_reason.description: e.g. zombie, owner, switched_off:actor; a plain code, never content

burn.description: passport identity: this agent's own usage window {window_hours, calls, tokens_in, tokens_out}; NO amounts ever (no usd, cost or micro_usd keys: Hub's money-surface rule; Mind strips menu.v1's cost_usd on this route); never part of config_version

may_pick.description: S18.3 (Hub 10-06): which models this agent may switch itself to. free_and_own = free models + models on the owner's own connected keys (never house-paid); none = only the owner chooses; list = the owner's explicit list. `models` = the ids the agent may pick RIGHT NOW (resolved), never prices. Existing owners start at none; owners/helpers created after the flag start at free_and_own.

source.description: owner = the owner's default for all agents; agent = this agent's own override

picked_by.description: 1.1.0: who set the current model/chain: agent = this agent switched itself (S18.3); null = nothing custom

ModelSwitch.description: Exactly one of model or chain. Every id must be in may_pick.models.

SwitchRefusal.description: 403 not_allowed_for_agent, in the envelope Mind answers on its agent/menu routes: {error:{code, message, retry_after_s, allowed}}; allowed = the models the agent MAY pick (ids only, no prices).

x-owner-notice.to: Hub Inbox (compute-alert), one per switch, batched to one per agent per hour
payload: undo (restores the chain from before the first switch of the batch)
added_by_hub: agent_name (Hub fills it from its own registry; Mind has no helper names)
x-owner-notice.batching: one event per switch; batch {count, first_from, first_from_label, first_from_chain, since} covers the agent last hour; Hub collapses cards by (passport, hour); a batched undo restores first_from_chain
